_meta.name: Outgunned Adventure
_meta.notes: Character options and Adventure gear from the complete genre book; the Quickstart is included as the companion source. Page references are printed book pages.

daredevil.name: The Daredevil
catchphrases: Leave it to me
Nothing ventured, nothing gained
I only gamble with my life
flaws: I never back down from a challenge

guardian.name: The Guardian
guardian.tagline: SELFLESS. WILL WATCH YOUR BACK. ADAMANT.
catchphrases: If it were to fall into the wrong hands…
I never change my mind
Nobody gets left behind
Go! I’ll take care of this
flaws: I don’t cooperate with the enemy

captain.name: The Captain
captain.tagline: WELL-TRAVELED. EYES ON THE HORIZON. PASSIONATE.
catchphrases: I chart my own course
Of course I can drive that
First time for everything
flaws: I have a debt to repay

hunter.name: The Hunter
catchphrases: Try not to do anything stupid
I don’t like this silence
You can never win against Nature

heart.name: The Heart
catchphrases: We can do this. Together
We won’t let this stop us
You’re stronger than you think
flaws: I believe I can save everyone
I always have to do what’s right

star.name: The Star
catchphrases: I performed in the greatest theaters
No one says no to me
Everything has a price

professor.name: The Professor
catchphrases: I’ve read it in a book
We never stop learning
The pen is mightier than the sword
flaws: I always have a theory to test
I don’t know when to shut up
Without my glasses, I am nearly blind

technician.name: The Technician
catchphrases: It doesn’t work like that…
What did I tell you?
Step back a little
flaws: I’m a fatalist and a pessimist

scoundrel.name: The Scoundrel
catchphrases: Do you trust me?
I’ve never seen this man before
It’s fine, they will never find us
flaws: I never tell the whole truth

smuggler.name: The Smuggler
catchphrases: Who d’you think you're talking to?
They don’t need it anymore
Either I do this, or somebody else will
flaws: I don’t believe in my friends

fortune_seeker.name: The Fortune Seeker
catchphrases: Could we talk about it later?
I’m sorry, I have to do this
I am the master of my own destiny
flaws: I never know when to stop
I always put the Treasure first

adventuring_author.name: Adventuring Author
adventuring_author.quote: You can’t just wait for inspiration. You have to chase it

born_rebel.name: Born Rebel
born_rebel.quote: Don’t tell me what I can’t do!

cold_and_distant.name: Cold and Distant
cold_and_distant.quote: Let me make one thing clear: We’re not friends.

cowardly_lion.name: Cowardly Lion
cowardly_lion.quote: Perhaps I should stay here and stand watch.

detestable_bastard.name: Detestable Bastard
detestable_bastard.quote: Looks to me like I’ve got all the horses!

flying_steamroller.name: Flying Steamroller
flying_steamroller.quote: If it’s got wings, I can crash it.

gentle_giant.name: Gentle Giant
gentle_giant.quote: There’s no need to get rough.

indispensable_rogue.name: Indispensable Rogue
indispensable_rogue.quote: Maybe someone got hurt. But it was nobody I knew.

parental_figure.name: Parental Figure
parental_figure.quote: No matter what happens, I am proud of you.

proper_gentleman_lady.name: Proper Gentleman/Lady
proper_gentleman_lady.quote: Unhand me! I say, this behavior is completely inappropriate.

reluctant_hero.name: Reluctant Hero
reluctant_hero.quote: Listen, I'm no hero... I’m just me.

salty_dog.name: Salty Dog
salty_dog.quote: The sea gives. The sea takes.

archeology.name: Archeology
archeology.summary: Free Re-rolls for archaeology, dead languages, and ancient civilizations’ history, culture, and legends.

artist.name: Artist
artist.summary: Choose an art form; gain Free Re-rolls for rolls about that art form.

big_and_strong.name: Big and Strong
big_and_strong.summary: Gain Help to lift or break objects, but a Hindrance to hide in small spaces or balance in unstable situations.

bodyguard.name: Bodyguard
bodyguard.summary: After another Adventurer fails, suffer the consequences of that failure in their stead.

chin_up.name: Chin Up
chin_up.summary: Remove Scared, Like a Fool, or another emotional Condition from an ally; at Camp, Cheer Up an ally without rolling.

disguise.name: Disguise
disguise.summary: Find, steal, or craft a perfect disguise for yourself and one other Adventurer without rolling.

estimate.name: Estimate
estimate.summary: Free Re-rolls to evaluate or date precious items, jewels, and ancient artifacts, or recognize fakes.

eye_for_details.name: Eye for Details
eye_for_details.summary: Come up with a helpful detail, such as a loophole or hidden passage, or ask the Director for a clue or suggestion.

explorer.name: Explorer
explorer.summary: Free Re-rolls when climbing, swimming, or traveling in wild environments.

fast_reflexes.name: Fast Reflexes
fast_reflexes.summary: React against an Enemy with Brawn+Stunt instead of the requested Skill and ignore all Condition and circumstance -1s.

favored_weapon.name: Favored Weapon
favored_weapon.summary: Choose a melee weapon; gain Free Re-rolls when using, repairing, evaluating, or handling it.

fighter.name: Fighter
fighter.summary: Free Re-rolls for Action and Reaction Rolls made while fighting human enemies with your hands.

fix_it.name: Fix-it
fix_it.summary: Free Re-rolls when repairing rides or disarming traps.

get_down.name: Get Down!
get_down.summary: You and another Adventurer hide, dodge bullets, or avoid being run over without rolling.

guide.name: Guide
guide.summary: Free Re-rolls when finding bearings, following tracks, locating food, or searching for friends.

gunslinger.name: Gunslinger
gunslinger.summary: Free Re-rolls when using, repairing, evaluating, or handling a pistol or revolver.

hardened.name: Hardened
hardened.summary: Free Re-rolls when intimidating others or resisting fear.

hawkeye.name: Hawkeye
hawkeye.summary: Choose a hunting rifle or bow for Free Re-rolls while handling it; spend 1 Luck to repeat a shooting Action Roll with it and keep the new result.

heartbreaker.name: Heartbreaker
heartbreaker.summary: Free Re-rolls when seducing or making a good impression.

i_meant_to_do_that.name: I Meant to Do That!
i_meant_to_do_that.summary: After failing a Reaction Roll not caused by an Enemy, immediately create a lucky turn of events or unexpected opportunity.

linguist.name: Linguist
linguist.summary: Free Re-rolls to understand or speak unknown languages; spend 1 Luck to become fluent in that language until Session end.

lockpicker.name: Lockpicker
lockpicker.summary: Free Re-rolls when picking locks, doors, or closed containers.

maverick.name: Maverick
maverick.summary: Free Re-rolls for Action Rolls that openly and clearly go against the group’s choices or directions.

moneybags.name: Moneybags
moneybags.summary: Start with 4 Cash; spend 1 Luck to find a contact, passage, invitation, or similar service through wealth or fame.

physician.name: Physician
physician.summary: Free Re-rolls to diagnose, operate on, or remove physical Conditions.

pilot.name: Pilot
pilot.summary: Free Re-rolls when piloting, repairing, or evaluating flying rides.

quick_and_nimble.name: Quick and Nimble
quick_and_nimble.summary: Gain Help to hide, sneak, or balance, but a Hindrance to lift or break objects.

quick_fingers.name: Quick Fingers
quick_fingers.summary: Free Re-rolls for sleight of hand; as a Full Turn, spend 1 Luck to retrieve a small lost item or keep one unnoticed during a search.

reassure.name: Reassure
reassure.summary: Give another Adventurer +1 before a roll of 4 dice or fewer, or let an ally with a filled Bad Box avoid a Condition.

saddle_up.name: Saddle Up
saddle_up.summary: You and one other Adventurer skip the next Reaction Turn while running.

sailor.name: Sailor
sailor.summary: Free Re-rolls when driving, repairing, or evaluating a nautical ride.

sensible_packer.name: Sensible Packer
sensible_packer.summary: Your Bag and Backpack never become a Hindrance; while carrying one, spend 1 Luck to find a tool or weapon worth at most 2$, unusable after the Scene.

silver_tongue.name: Silver Tongue
silver_tongue.summary: Free Re-rolls to lie, persuade, find a compromise, or bargain.

skulker.name: Skulker
skulker.summary: Free Re-rolls when hiding or sneaking in wild environments; ignore Partial Cover drawbacks in the wilds.

specialist.name: Specialist
specialist.summary: Choose a technical specialty; gain Free Re-rolls for rolls concerning it.

subterfuge.name: Subterfuge
subterfuge.summary: Free Re-rolls when lying, deceiving, or cheating.

teamwork.name: Teamwork
teamwork.summary: After another Adventurer gives you an Assist this Turn, spend 1 Luck to gain an automatic success without rolling.

that_was_close.name: That Was Close!
that_was_close.summary: Repeat any Reaction Roll, ignoring all Condition and circumstance -1s; keep the new result.

thrill_seeker.name: Thrill Seeker
thrill_seeker.summary: Free Re-rolls when dodging bullets, arrows, or triggered traps, and when getting out of the way or finding cover.

too_young_to_die.name: Too Young To Die
too_young_to_die.summary: When a Young Adventurer fills the Bad Box, they suffer no Condition; unavailable when Advancing.

trailblazer.name: Trailblazer
trailblazer.summary: Create a safe path, alternative route, space, or opening using technical or natural knowledge.

watch_and_learn.name: Watch and Learn
watch_and_learn.summary: After another Adventurer succeeds at an Action Roll this Turn, automatically succeed at the same action without rolling.

elegant_clothes.name: Elegant Clothes
elegant_clothes.description: Grant Help for stylish occasions but are a Hindrance to movement.

lockpicking_set.name: Lockpicking Set
lockpicking_set.description: Grants Help to pick locks and disarm traps.

tool_bag.name: Tool-bag
tool_bag.description: Grants Help to repair objects or rides.

grappling_hook.name: Grappling Hook
grappling_hook.description: Grants Help to climb and swing.

compass.name: Compass
compass.description: Grants Help to find your bearings or magnetic North.

winter_clothes.name: Winter Clothes
winter_clothes.description: Grant Help to withstand cold or bad weather.

lantern.name: Lantern
lantern.description: Grants Help to see in the dark but is a Hindrance when hiding.

climbing_gear.name: Climbing Gear
climbing_gear.description: Grants Help when climbing walls made of rock or ice.

camping_cookware.name: Camping Cookware
camping_cookware.description: Grants Help to cook in a Camp.

musical_instrument.name: Musical Instrument
musical_instrument.description: Allows you to play and perform.

old_ride.name: Old Ride
old_ride.description: An old plane, ship, or jeep.

lighter.name: Lighter
lighter.description: Grants Help to light a fire.

radio.name: Radio
radio.description: Allows communication at a distance; Bulky.

old_rifle.name: Old Rifle
old_rifle.description: Slow Reload; allows you to shoot with +1.

hunting_rifle.name: Hunting Rifle
hunting_rifle.description: Accurate, Slow Reload; allows you to shoot with +1.

shotgun.name: Shotgun
shotgun.description: Impact, Slow Reload; allows you to shoot with +1.

machine_gun.name: Machine Gun
machine_gun.description: Rapid Fire; allows you to shoot with +1.

gatling_gun.name: Gatling Gun
gatling_gun.description: Fixed, Rapid Fire, Uncommon; allows you to shoot with +2.

bow.name: Bow
bow.description: Silent, Single Shot; allows you to shoot arrows.

hunting_bow.name: Hunting Bow
hunting_bow.description: Accurate, Silent, Single Shot; allows you to shoot arrows with +1.

whip.name: Whip
whip.description: Melee Weapon; can be used to grab distant items.

rocket_launcher.name: Rocket Launcher
rocket_launcher.description: Boom!, Single Shot, Slow Reload, Uncommon; allows you to shoot with +1.

projectiles.name: Projectiles
projectiles.description: 10 arrows for a bow or 1 rocket for a rocket launcher.

mags.name: Mags (2)
mags.description: Two mags for a type of weapon of your choice.

diary.name: Diary
diary.description: An everyday object; included with the Professor’s starting gear.

gearChoices.any_weapon: Any weapon from the Adventure gear table.
gearChoices.any_item: Any item from the Adventure gear table.
gearChoices.precious_item: A precious item of choice, such as jewelry or a golden lighter.
